content:
Due to popular demand (@Patrick Massot :-) for some of the goodies recently arriving in Lean, we have cut an additional release candidate v4.2.0-rc2.

This brings a 14.4% improvement to Mathlib's wall-clock!

It also revealed that we've been taking advantage of a bug for some time in Mathlib, and so there are now many comments added reminding us that we'll need to fix various defeq abuses and do some cleanup. Please see the discussion around #7606 for details.
